'''Naboo tile''' was a type of material used to cover walls. [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]'s stateroom located on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] the [[Shelter]] had [[Stone/Legends|stone]] walls which had been made to resemble the tile.<ref name="Rebirth">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]''</ref>
